## 更新 · What's new

- 公网中继 SDK 升级至 `JunWeiUp/common-relay` v0.2.3（macOS 与 Flutter 同步锁定版本），修复 v2 中继流在连续突发帧（如积压通知 ACK、剪贴板批量回放或文件分块）下的并发解密异常、首帧预缓存竞态、异常关闭未通知对端导致残留僵尸会话以及无订阅关闭挂起问题。
  Upgraded the Internet relay SDK to `JunWeiUp/common-relay` v0.2.3 across macOS and Flutter with pinned lockfiles, fixing v2 relay stream burst decryption concurrency errors, pre-attach frame race drops, missing `stream.close` notifications on local errors, and unsubscribed stream close deadlocks.
- 修复 Flutter 端公网中继设备映射与按需建流：将中继在线设备严格按已解析的 `lanPeerId` 发布到设备列表，避免与 `relayDeviceId` 混用造成重复设备或入队错位；`openPeer` 反向定位对应中继设备 ID 按需建立隧道，并保留诊断错误日志。
  Fixed Flutter relay peer publishing and on-demand tunnel opening: map online relay peers strictly by resolved `lanPeerId` instead of raw `relayDeviceId`, resolve `relayDeviceId` from `lanPeerId` in `openPeer`, and surface relay tunnel errors in diagnostics logs.
- 统一双端 `/v2/ws` 入站流仲裁并优化 macOS 入站接管：macOS 接入常驻 `onSocket` 回调直接响应入站中继流，避免等待不可达私网地址探测或残留挂起事件；双端在 presence 同步时跳过自身设备，消除每 30 秒一次的无效网络探测。
  Unified v2 inbound stream arbitration across platforms and streamlined macOS inbound relay handling via a persistent `onSocket` handler; skipped self-device entries during presence reconciliation to eliminate redundant 30-second network probes.
- 优化 Flutter 发送文本弹窗交互，支持回车直接提交发送。
  Improved the Flutter Send Text dialog to support submitting directly from the keyboard.
